historical_references.reference: Ramji was a prominent Maratha warrior of the seventeenth century who served under the great Maratha king Shivaji. He played a crucial role in the Battle of Pratapgarh (1659) and the subsequent conquest of the strategically important hill fortress of Torna.

Ramji was also a renowned Jain scholar and philosopher in medieval India. He authored several texts on Jain philosophy and contributed significantly to the development of the Digambara sect. His major works include 'Tattvartha-sutra-vartika' and 'Shrutakamala'.
